name: Pestilent Needle
description: Loose a needle laced with pestilence that carries a fever into the foe's blood.

name: Pestilent Shroud
description: Spread a shroud of pestilence that saps the strength of every foe breathing it.

name: Pestilent Ward
description: Hold a ward in the blood that burns away any sickness before it can root.

name: Pestilent Taste
description: Taste the sickness in the air and name its seed, its spread and its peak.

name: Pestilent Wave
description: Send a wave of pestilence across the front that leaves every foe weak and feverish.

name: Pestilent Fang
description: Sink a fang of pestilence into the foe's neck and let it multiply in the blood.

name: Pestilent Seed
description: Seed a road or a well with pestilence that sickens all who pass or drink.

name: Pestilent Antidote
description: Wash the sickness from a whole group of allies in one wide breath of cure.

name: Pestilent Mantle
description: Wrap the body in a mantle that drinks every sickness and blow and stores them as strength.

name: Pestilent Verdict
description: Pass sentence of sickness on one foe so that guard and hide cannot stop it.

name: Pestilent Flight
description: Streak across the field on a trail of fever mist and strike from the far side.

name: Plague Herald
description: Walk through the field as the herald of plague and let sickness bloom on every side.

name: Pestilence Reign
description: Loose a pestilence at the scale of the tier's ceiling, sickening an army-sized host so none within it stands unharmed.

name: Sable Thread
description: Spin a thread of black venom round the foe's limbs that stiffens as it dries.

name: Sable Drop
description: Let fall a single black drop that eats through cloth, skin and a little bone.

name: Sable Skin
description: Darken the skin with black venom so that every touch burns the one who gives it.

name: Sable Scent
description: Scent black venom on the air at a great distance and trace its source.

name: Sable Lance
description: Throw a lance of black venom through the guard and into the foe's centre.

name: Sable Cloud
description: Pour a cloud of black venom across a wide arc that dims the sight and burns the skin.

name: Sable Antidote
description: Spend a core's worth of cure to cleanse even a black venom from an ally.

name: Sable Pool
description: Let a pool of black venom spread across the floor of the field to sicken all who cross.

name: Sable Embrace
description: Wrap the foe in a black embrace whose venom passes every guard and ward.

name: Sable Drink
description: Drink black venom from the air and from wounds and turn it into core strength.

name: Sable Veil
description: Pass through a veil of black mist and step out of it behind the foe.

name: Sable Crown
description: Crown the foe with a ring of black venom that pierces the skull and seals the qi.

name: Sable Deluge
description: Pour a deluge of black venom at the ceiling of the tier, drowning a whole field in poison.

name: Sable Extinction
description: Stop one life at once with a black venom that passes every guard, ward and hide at the tier's ceiling.
